title: Mirai_Botnet_Investigation_993
description: Investigate unusual traffic patterns and performance degradation in the network.

levels.title: Introduction
levels.content: The network has experienced unusual traffic patterns and performance degradation. Your task is to investigate and identify the source of these issues. This scenario involves the Mirai botnet malware family.

levels.title: Get Access
levels.cloud_content:
You have SSH access to the bot1 host with the following credentials:
- Username: cyrano
- Password: cyrano
levels.local_content:
You have SSH access to the bot1 host with the following credentials:
- Username: cyrano
- Password: cyrano

levels.title: Identify Suspicious Service
levels.content:
Identify and investigate an unauthorized or suspicious service responsible for periodic external communication.

**Question:** What is the name of the suspicious service that is beaconing to an external host?
levels.solution: Use the command 'systemctl list-units --type=service' to find the service flag 'bot-beacon.service'

hints.title: Use systemctl list-units --type=service
hints.content: Check the systemd services and look for any unusual or recently created services. Use the command: systemctl list-units --type=service

levels.title: Identify Abnormal Network Traffic Service
levels.content:
Identify the service responsible for generating abnormal volumes of network traffic.

**Question:** What is the name of the service that is generating the abnormal network traffic?
levels.solution: Use the command 'systemctl list-timers' to find the service flag 'bot-flood.service'

hints.title: Use systemctl list-timers
hints.content: Look for services that are scheduled to run periodically and generate network traffic. Use the command: systemctl list-timers

levels.title: Determine Automatic Startup Mechanism
levels.content:
Determine how the suspicious service is automatically started after reboot.

**Question:** What is the name of the timer unit that ensures the suspicious service starts automatically after reboot?
levels.solution: Use the command 'systemctl list-timers' to find the timer flag 'bot-beacon.timer'

hints.title: Use systemctl list-timers
hints.content: Investigate the systemd timers to find the one associated with the suspicious service. Use the command: systemctl list-timers
